goal: Prevent local credential leakage and node hijacking when the default IPv4 RPC port is occupied
Require the IPv4 loopback bind to succeed and fail closed if any explicitly specified endpoint fails
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Verified closing a real credential leak through testing (janb84, winterrdog)
Concept approval noting bitcoin-cli defaults to IPv4 (winterrdog, l0rinc, janb84, sedited)
Open suggestions on endpoint deduplication, test simplification, and error hints (l0rinc)

categories.name: rpc
why: P1 because it fixes a security issue where rogue local processes can capture RPC credentials
Prevents local attackers on multi-user systems from hijacking the node over IPv6
